tools.name: check_service_area
tools.description: Answer "do you serve <city or ZIP>?" for ORS Clean's South Bay / Silicon Valley / Central Coast area. Not required before request_quote, which checks the service area itself. Returns the nearest served city when the answer is no.

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Request an ORS Clean quote for gutter cleaning, gutter guards & minor repair, pressure washing, roof cleaning, solar panel cleaning, house wash + windows, window cleaning, fence/deck staining, or commercial/HOA work in Gilroy, Morgan Hill, San Jose, Hollister, Watsonville, Salinas, Campbell, Los Gat

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: request_quote · Private data: about_ors_clean · Public sink: request_quote.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: request_quote · Private data: about_ors_clean · Public sink: request_quote

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
